newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES RISE ON YEN'S WEAKER TONE.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES RISE ON YEN'S WEAKER TONE.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended a day of lacklustre activity a tad firmer on Tuesday, supported by the yen's weaker tone against the dollar and gains in other commodity futures such as grain, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 2.2 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark January was up 1.5 yen at 121.1 yen.
"The rubber market was influenced by the currency market and other commodity prices as this market continued to suffer from a dearth of fresh incentives," a commodity broker said.
Amid the summer holidays, prices are likely to move within limited ranges, he said.
